title: The payer's PO is required rule blocks invoicing with no Customer PO
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with PO is required off.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with PO is required on.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B, with Customer PO empty.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Create Invoice.
  4. Type a purchase order number in Customer PO.
  5. Click Create Invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows an empty Customer PO.

Step 3:

  • No invoice is created: customer B's PO rule applies and the work order asks for a Customer PO, as it does today for a customer whose PO is required.

Step 4:

  • Customer PO shows the number.

Step 5:

  • The invoice is created.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • S7-R4: “The Bill To's "PO is required" applies to Customer PO.”
  • Feature Overview, State by action (Action | Open | Invoiced | Internal or No Charge): “Create the invoice | Allowed, unless the Bill To is on Credit Hold (M2) or requires a PO and Customer PO is empty | n/a | No invoice”
  • Feature Overview, Core Bill To: “The Bill To owns the receivable: payment terms and due date, credit limit, Credit Hold, Customer PO and "PO is required", deposits, payments, credits, the QuickBooks invoice customer, IBS, the portal Pay button and the invoice email.”
